questions.question: Which of these classes of amplifiers has the highest efficiency?
Which of the following describes the function of a two-input AND gate?

choices.A: Output is high when either or both inputs are low
choices.B: Output is high only when both inputs are high
choices.C: Output is low when either or both inputs are high
choices.D: Output is low only when both inputs are high

questions.answer: Output is high only when both inputs are high

questions.question: In a Class A amplifier, what percentage of the time does the amplifying device conduct?
How many states does a 3-bit binary counter have?

questions.question: Which of the following are basic components of a sine wave oscillator?

choices.B: A frequency multiplier and a mixer
choices.C: A circulator and a filter operating in a feed-forward loop
choices.D: A filter and an amplifier operating in a feedback loop

questions.answer: A filter and an amplifier operating in a feedback loop

questions.question: How is the efficiency of an RF power amplifier determined?

choices.A: Divide the DC input power by the DC output power
choices.B: Divide the RF output power by the DC input power
choices.C: Multiply the RF input power by the reciprocal of the RF output power
choices.D: Add the RF input power to the DC output power

questions.answer: Divide the RF output power by the DC input power

questions.question: What determines the frequency of an LC oscillator?

choices.A: The number of stages in the counter
choices.B: The number of stages in the divider
choices.C: The inductance and capacitance in the tank circuit
choices.D: The time delay of the lag circuit

questions.answer: The inductance and capacitance in the tank circuit

questions.question: Which of the following describes a linear amplifier?

choices.A: Any RF power amplifier used in conjunction with an amateur transceiver
choices.B: An amplifier in which the output preserves the input waveform
choices.C: A Class C high efficiency amplifier
choices.D: An amplifier used as a frequency multiplier

questions.answer: An amplifier in which the output preserves the input waveform
